learning_outcomes.text: The course depicts a complete scenario on the techniques and methodologies currently established for the design of automatic machines and industrial robots; it simultaneously proposes basic concepts for the choice of commercial solutions to tackle problems usually found on the field, as motion of mechanical organs (electric motors, actuators) and preserving the stiffness of complex assemblies.

assessment_rules: Assessment criteria for grading range from insufficient (Fail) for serious conceptual errors and lack of understanding, to excellent (29-30 and Honors) for complete, in-depth knowledge, independent operation, and critical thinking. Honors (Laude) is awarded for exceptional work.
bibliography: E. I. Rivin, Mechanical Design of Robots, 1988, McGraw-Hill
M. Giglio et al., Costruzione di Macchine, 2011, McGraw-Hill
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica (Mechanical Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
